table: player_market_values_dedup, year 2026 rows whose club is 'Without Club', read from the 2026-10-02 dump (market-2025-2026.json in the lead's kit, the same dump Round 1015 baked the rosters from). 17 such rows.
rule: A man ships as a real free agent only when two independent non wiki sources, read on checkedOn, say he has no club and no source says he has signed or retired. A live career page counts as read on checkedOn. Anyone in a baked 2026 squad is dropped whatever his status, because a man cannot be on a club's books and unattached at once. Ages, positions and values are the table's, exactly as the roster bake takes them.

sources.says: Listed among the players still without a club, last club Monterrey.
Career ends at Monterrey, Feb 2025 to Dec 2025; no later club.

unattached.note: Aston Villa talks were reported in mid September (caughtoffside.com 2026-09-16); nothing found saying they finished in a signing.

Career ends at Wydad Casablanca, Jan 2026 to Jul 2026; no later club.

unattached.note: Thin: no dated source after July 2026 says either way; the claim rests on nothing newer having appeared. livefoot.fr's feed, read 2026-10-06, has him signing a six month renewable deal at Wydad on 2026-01-07 and nothing about a club after June 2026.

Career list ends at Ujpest, Jul 2025 to Apr 2026, but the page header still names Ujpest as his club.
Still lists Ujpest, contract to June 2027.

dropped.note: Dropped in the review of this round: no source dated after June 2026 says he is still without a club, the newest one reported a move as days away, and both live pages still name Ujpest. Ships again only on a September or October source. The table's age is a year low: FotMob and Soccerway both give 10 July 1994, so he was 32 in August 2026.
